description: Kirawanagama (Part), Viharagala, FVP. No. 306 and P.P. No. Ba. 669 of Haldummulla (Part), Haldummulla D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, uses, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
